The team had to make sure that each component was measured correctly, or else the bomb would not work. They had to ensure that each component was placed in the correct position, or else the bomb would malfunction.

Billy Bob knew that time was running out. The squirrels were just about to finish their assembly line, and Billy Bob had to act fast.
